data_output.description: Unchanged. data.encode returns encoded['train'], encoded['valid'], and encoded['test'] as (features, labels, users). Features remain int32 matrices with five columns ordered [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday]. Validation labels are float32 long_view targets; test labels are None because load is called with include_test_labels=False. Validation and test feature row order is the canonical source-row order after split filtering.

model_input.description: Unchanged. Model receives the existing total encoded dimension plus the configured learning_rate and l2. Training step receives same-shape two-dimensional positive and negative encoded feature matrices with exactly five columns. Prediction receives an encoded feature matrix and returns one score per input row.
